title: The Latest Crier for May 05, 2026
items:
Bot Bash Robotics Competition Tonight!

Assemble your robot and compete for a chance to win a cool prize! Teams will be assigned at the event, materials are provided, and no experience necessary! 
Where: VSC 243 

When: May 4th 6-8pm 

Winning team gets gift cards to Sweet Henry’s! 

We hope to see you tonight! 

Contact geistkempers1@central.edu or jablonskig1@central.edu if you have any questions!

Meal plan change for Fall 2026

Now is a good time to review your meal plan for next fall. If you are wanting to make a change to your meal plan for next fall please call or email Renae, 641-628-5656 or toolr@central.edu.

Central Student Tradition – Breakfast of Champions SP26 – Monday, May 11, 9:30-10:30PM

The annual student tradition Breakfast of Champions is back Monday, May 11 from 9:30-10:30PM! Enjoy Breakfast favs–Fresh toppings bar–fresh local donuts–all beverage stations will be open! Celebrate the end of the semester with a late-night study break where staff and faculty serve up delicious food, encouragement, and fun!

SAVE THE DATE-Business (EAM) & STEM Internship Career Fair

Mark your calendar for Tuesday, September 8, 2026 | 11:00am-1:00pm | Graham Conference Center 
Do your prep this summer: 

Submit your resume for review to Handshake. Create or update your LinkedIn profile. 

Visit Career Readiness & Experiential Learning site on myCentral for more resources.

Summer Online Spanish 122 (Beginning Spanish II)

Want to keep building your Spanish skills this summer? Enroll in Spanish 122OL , an engaging online course offered during Central College’s 10-week Summer Session from June 1 through August 7, 2026 . Please contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga with any questions.

Central College Slow Pitch Club Meeting!

The Central College Slowpitch Club will be having its first ever introduction and first meeting on Tuesday May 5th in Van Emmerick (Maytag 2nd floor) from 11:30am-12:30pm! All students who are interested in joining are welcome! We will talk about our direction as a club as well as any opportunities that are possible. If you can't attend but are interested please email luchiv1@central.edu!
